# SkillWaala

> SkillWaala is a free online and offline learning platform offering industry-ready courses, internships, and talent recruitment services across digital marketing, web development, animation, and AI tools.

SkillWaala provides comprehensive skill training programs in Jaipur and online, with a focus on certification, practical experience through internships, and direct recruitment opportunities for employers. The platform specializes in digital marketing, full-stack web development, animation, content writing, and emerging AI tools.

## Key Topics

- Digital Marketing
- Web Development
- SEO
- Social Media Marketing
- Content Writing
- Animation
- Google Ads
- Meta Ads
- MERN Stack
- Free Certification
- Internships
- JavaScript
- React
- Performance Marketing
- AI Tools

## Core Platforms

- [SkillWaala Homepage](https://www.skillwaala.com): Main landing page: free online/offline courses in digital marketing, animation, web development with certificates
- [Course Catalog](https://www.skillwaala.com/courses): Complete course directory featuring AI tools, digital marketing, animation, web development, content writing
- [Internships in Jaipur](https://www.skillwaala.com/internships-in-jaipur): Internship programs in Jaipur for digital marketing, data science, animation, web development with certification
- [Hire Industry Ready Talent](https://www.skillwaala.com/hire-from-us): B2B recruitment platform to hire trained interns and job-ready candidates from SkillWaala

## Digital Marketing Courses

- [Digital Marketing Course](https://www.skillwaala.com/digital-marketing-course): Free advanced digital marketing course covering Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, SMO with certification
- [SEO Training Course](https://www.skillwaala.com/seo-training-course): Free SEO course covering on-page, off-page, technical SEO with Google tools and SEMrush
- [Social Media Marketing Course](https://www.skillwaala.com/social-media-marketing-course): Free social media marketing course covering Meta Ads, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook ads
- [Performance Marketing Course](https://www.skillwaala.com/performance-marketing-course): Free AI-powered performance marketing course with Meta Ads, Google Ads, ecommerce focus

## Development & Creative Courses

- [Full Stack Web Development Course](https://www.skillwaala.com/web-development-course): Free MERN stack web development course with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React, placement aid
- [Animation Course in Jaipur](https://www.skillwaala.com/animation-course-in-jaipur): Free animation course covering Adobe tools, 2D animation, motion graphics, VFX training
- [Content Writing Course](https://www.skillwaala.com/content-writing-course): Free content writing course in Jaipur with SEO basics, copywriting, and job assistance

## AI & Tools Reference

- [AI Tools Directory](https://www.skillwaala.com/ai-tools): AI tools directory with comparisons, reviews, and performance analysis for ChatGPT and other AI platforms
